datasets.name: Work function and cleavage energy surface database
datasets.description: High-throughput DFT work functions and cleavage energies for crystal-surface slabs, with structures, orientations, terminations and calculation metadata.
datasets.count_display: 58,332 unrelaxed surface records; separate selected relaxed subset of 90
datasets.count_scope: WF-CE_database_58332.json; the 90 relaxed extreme-work-function records are an overlapping follow-up subset
datasets.license: Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial 4.0 International (CC BY-NC 4.0)

sources.title: Work Function and Cleavage Energy Database
sources.evidence: Release describes 58,332 unrelaxed slab records, 90 selected relaxed records, and per-record slab geometries with MP IDs.

sources.title: Zenodo release metadata
sources.evidence: Version 2.1 metadata identifies CC BY-NC 4.0 licensing.

caveats: Configurations are surface orientation/termination slabs, not 58,332 distinct bulk compounds.
Most records are unrelaxed slabs; 90 selected low/high-work-function slabs were ionically relaxed.
Surface parent materials overlap Materials Project; follow-up relaxed records must not be added as independent materials.
The non-commercial restriction matters for reuse.

datasets.name: Perovskite Database Project (solar cells)
datasets.description: Literature-curated metal-halide perovskite solar-cell devices, linking compositions, device stacks, synthesis, performance and bibliographic provenance.
datasets.version: 2021 publication historical corpus; current hosting migrated to NOMAD by 2026
datasets.count_display: over 42,400 devices in the publication corpus
datasets.count_scope: Historical Nature Energy release extracted from literature published through February 2020; not a current device-total assertion
datasets.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (data, unless otherwise noted); MIT (code)

sources.title: An open-access database and analysis tool for perovskite solar cells based on the FAIR data principles
sources.evidence: Methods reports manual extraction of over 42,400 devices through February 2020; records describe device/process/performance attributes and DOI links.

sources.title: Perovskite Database official project page
sources.evidence: Official page states hosting migrated from MaterialsZone to NOMAD after the 2020–2026 period and links the current database and code.

sources.title: Perovskite Database license
sources.evidence: Unless otherwise noted, database data are CC BY 4.0 and code MIT.

caveats: Device records are not independent crystal structures or unique perovskite compositions.
Atomic coordinates are not a required input; the catalogue row is composition/process/property context.
If only averaged device measurements were available, the original curation could represent those as one entry and record the number averaged.
The paper appeared online in 2021 and in Nature Energy volume 7 (2022); the count is historical.
The collection’s old MaterialsZone access route has been superseded by the official NOMAD migration.

datasets.name: Topological Quantum Chemistry all-band materials catalog
datasets.description: DFT and symmetry-based catalog of stable and fragile electronic band topology in nonmagnetic stoichiometric ICSD entries.
datasets.count_scope: Historical 2022 all-band topological classification cohort; the count is processable ICSD entries, not unique formulas or exclusively topological materials

sources.title: All Topological Bands of All Nonmagnetic Stoichiometric Materials
sources.evidence: Authors report a publicly accessible all-band topology catalog for 96,196 processable ICSD entries; the abstract provides official portal and mirror links.

sources.title: All Topological Bands, full author manuscript
sources.evidence: Workflow filters ICSD entries for stoichiometry and valid atomic coordinates and calculates symmetry-indicated band topology by DFT.

caveats: This is an ICSD-derived property cohort and overlaps experimental crystal-structure databases.
The 96,196 entries include both topological and trivial classifications; they are not 96,196 topological discoveries.
Public classification access does not establish unrestricted redistribution rights to underlying ICSD coordinates.
Primary portal timed out during this audit; scope and count are verified from the authors’ paper, and current portal availability is not confirmed.
Nonmagnetic and stoichiometric scope omits disordered and magnetic materials.

datasets.name: NLR MatDB (formerly NRELMatDB)
datasets.description: Computational database for renewable-energy materials with relaxed crystal structures, formation thermochemistry and GW electronic/optical properties.
datasets.count_scope: No current numeric release size was verified from the official portal

sources.title: NLR MatDB official portal
sources.evidence: Current provider describes stoichiometric fully ordered materials, DFT-relaxed structures, thermochemistry and GW electronic data, with methodology citations.

sources.title: NLR MatDB help
sources.evidence: Identifies the current computational materials database, its institutional team and photovoltaic-materials discovery scope.

caveats: Old collection URL materials.nrel.gov returned an error; the current official service is materials.nlr.gov.
Count and explicit dataset license remain unverified.
Planned defect and surface properties listed on the homepage are not treated as released data.
The cited formation-energy methodology paper is not a complete frozen dataset descriptor.

coverage_notes: Four primary-source-verified additions proposed; canonical data files were not modified.
AQCat25, MatSyn25 and OCx24 are delegated to the other collection scout to avoid duplicate proposed records.
Remaining candidate gaps retain their discovery URLs in collection_sedaoturak.json and have not been promoted to ranked datasets without primary verification.
